headline: built JevGuard with Jev (@typesafeai)
text:
built JevGuard with Jev (@typesafeai)

hooks into @opencode, reviews each turn against .jev/ rules

Jev gives the odds a rule was broken; code decides PASS/WARN/FAIL

on FAIL it drafts a fix, never edits code

a bundled skill writes your rules.md
